Map.title: Cyber threat map
Map.stageLabel: Interactive globe with attacks from the last 24 h. The same data is in the side panels.

typeText.scan: IPs reported for port scans, password guessing and other abuse (AbuseIPDB).
typeText.malware: Servers that distribute malicious software (URLhaus, ThreatFox).
typeText.botnet: Command-and-control (C2) servers coordinating compromised devices (Feodo Tracker, ThreatFox).
typeText.ddos: Application-layer (HTTP) flood attacks, based on Cloudflare Radar.

Map.sourcesText: We aggregate Cloudflare Radar (trend, rankings and origin–target pairs for L7 DDoS attacks), abuse.ch (ThreatFox, Feodo Tracker, URLhaus) and AbuseIPDB. IPs are geolocated at country level with DB-IP Lite and are not stored: we keep only per-country counts. The arcs on the globe represent these weights, not individual attacks; for scans, malware and botnets we only know the source country, so the target follows Cloudflare Radar's target distribution.
Map.honesty: This page shows aggregated trends. The source country shows where infrastructure sits, not who is behind an attack.
Map.worriedText: Our team can check your organisation’s exposure.
